longitude_basis: Official LCO calendar: west longitude 4h42m48s. Observatory-level daytime boundary only; not a claimed geodetic Warsaw-telescope coordinate.
derivation: Julian days begin at Greenwich noon. Adding east-positive longitude/360 gives local-mean-solar Julian phase; integer boundaries occur near local noon. TDB is used consistently with model times, with no claim of exact apparent solar noon; clock/equation-of-time minute differences are far from observations and do not affect this day partition.
rule: OGLE only: local_day=floor(time_jd_tdb + longitude_deg_east_positive/360); heldout iff local_day % 5 == 0. All HST retained in training. Preserve native values and all row IDs.
original_v2_rule_retained: floor(time_jd_tdb-.5)%5 == 0; exact conditional score valid but not whole-night validation because Chilean observing nights cross this midnight boundary.
qualification: This correction repairs the stated whole-observing-night validation unit before prediction outcomes; it does not remove cross-night GP correlations, certify independence, change baseline fits, or select a model by its mass. Exact conditional score still accounts for GP train/heldout covariance. Frozen original partition and its limitation remain auditable.
